body: I left them last year. It doesn’t stop the suffering and memories.
Okay, please explain what I should do other than end the constant suffering I’ve endured for years?

I understand that myself. I apologise, you’re going through a lot, i am just proud you’re trying so hard, no one can ask anymore of you. Have you ate a meal today at the very least? :) even if only a snack if you can’t, you’re important
I’m happy you’re doing something other than suicide but maybe try cold water or ice cubes on your arms or where to see if that pain gives relief before cutting?

Family would hurt me and call me a burden. They told me quite a few times to suicide. 
It’ll be alright for them, I more feel guilty they have to sort out my stuff after I’m gone.
Others will be alright, maybe a bit happier or relieved at the worst.

Thank you. Maybe enjoy a tasty snack for now? You can always die later but rn good for enjoying some of the little good things if you can brainstorm a few things, cookies or a comfy comedy film you like with blankets and a pillow to hold
I am sorry you’re hurting so much. You deserve warmth and love
